content.text:
Perfect! All 180 tests pass. I've successfully added a voucher system to invoices:

**Added to src/errors.js:**
- `VOUCHER_EXISTS`: "This invoice already has a voucher applied."

**Updated invoiceTotals in src/invoices.js:**
- Now returns `{ subtotal, discount, vat, voucher, total }`
- voucher = invoice.voucher?.amount ?? 0
- total = subtotal - discount + vat - voucher (clamped at 0)
- Vouchers are applied after VAT

**Added applyVoucher(invoice, { code, amount }) to src/invoices.js:**
- Takes fixed amount in cents off invoice
- Only works on draft invoices (NOT_DRAFT if not draft)
- One voucher per invoice (VOUCHER_EXISTS if already has voucher)
- Amount must be positive integer (AMOUNT_INVALID for invalid amounts)
- Returns ok(newInvoice) with invoice.voucher = { code, amount }
- Stores both code and amount in the voucher object
- Preserves all existing invoice data (terms, dueDate, lines, etc.)

**Added 11 comprehensive tests covering:**
- Applying voucher to draft invoice
- Preventing duplicate vouchers (VOUCHER_EXISTS)
- Rejecting voucher application on issued invoices (NOT_DRAFT)
- Validating amount (negative, zero, non-integer amounts)
- invoiceTotals calculations with vouchers
- Clamping total at 0 when voucher exceeds total
- Data preservation and immutability

**Key features:**
- Voucher reduces invoice total after all other calculations (discount, VAT)
- Example: Subtotal €425 - Discount €42.50 + VAT €89.25 - Voucher €50 = €421.75
- Cannot apply voucher on issued or paid invoices
- Cannot apply multiple vouchers to same invoice
- Total always clamped at 0 (no negative amounts)

All 180 tests passing.
